svg.title: C17-M05-F3: Recovery order for cyber recovery
svg.desc: A sequence from evidence preservation and a clean environment through network, identity, data and applications to integrity checks, staged reconnection and monitoring.
svg.text: C17-M05-F3 Recovery order for cyber recovery
isolate & preserve evidence -> clean environment -> network/DNS ->
identity (SSO, PKI) -> core data (restore + scan) -> applications ->
integrity checks -> staged reconnection -> heightened monitoring
Figure C17-M05-F3. A typical restoration sequence after a cyber incident.
